page.overview:
What is Blueberry Academy?

The Blueberry Academy is a location featured in the Indigo Disk expansion of . The player is introduced into this academy as an exchange student from their academy. It is located somewhere in Unova's waters. The academy is big enough to have its own regional Pokédex.

The academy was created by Cyrano, who spent a large amount of money in its creation. The majority of the academy is actually underwater, containing all sorts of facilities such as indoor classrooms, dormitories, a cafeteria, and their famed Terarium. There are many battle courts placed in the academy, though some take place on the surface, where the most prominent battles are fought.

Like the Naranja and Uva Academies, Blueberry Academy has their own uniform for students. The students place great emphasis on Double Battles. There are also various clubs for students to join in, though the most prominent of them all is the League Club, which oversees the Blueberry League. The club's president is the League Champion. While the academy does take Pokémon Dollar and League Points, they also have their own currency, Blueberry Points, which students can acquire from completing Blueberry Quests (BBQ), often involving various activities in the Terarium.

The entrance is where the player first arrives to the academy. After going through the initial tour of the academy, the player can find Cyrano there.
